title: Investigator-Initiiated Intraoperative Pancreatic Leakage Indicator Exploratory Randomized Controlled Multicenter Trial (IDEAL Stage IIb) - mViP
summary:
Pancreatic surgery is essential for treating various pancreatic diseases but still carries significant risks, including a complication called postoperative pancreatic fistula (POPF), which can lead to serious issues like infections and bleeding. Despite improvements in surgical techniques, up to 50% of these surgeries can result in POPF. Current prevention methods are not very effective.
To address this, a new medical device called SmartPAN® has been developed. It uses a special dye to detect leaks from the operated pancreas during surgery, which are not visible to the naked eye and that hat can lead to POPF. Previous studies show that SmartPAN® can help surgeons identify and fix these leaks, potentially reducing complications after surgery. The device has been tested and found to be safe, with no adverse effects.
In the mViP study, 100 patients shall be included in one of two groups (pancreatic resection with usage of SmartPAN® and targeted closure of the leakage site versus pancreatic resection with usage of SmartPAN® without targeted closure of the leakage site). Allocation will be randomized (randomized-controlled). The aim of the study is to examine whether the POPF rate can be reduced by using the SmartPAN®. The study will be conducted on several trial sites.

interventions.name: Usage of SmartPAN® indicator with targeted closure of leakage sites in case of positive  indicator reaction during distal pancreatectomy.
Usage of SmartPAN® indicator without targeted closure of leakage sites in case of positive  indicator reaction during distal pancreatectomy.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Planned distal pancreatectomy for any indication including minimally invasive and open surgery and including multivisceral resection.
2. Age ≥ 18 years 
3. Ability of subject to understand character and individual consequences of the clinical trial.
4.Written informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
1. American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) Score > 3
2. Pregnancy or lactation
3. Allergy or known intolerability to bromothymol blue or potato starch
4. Participation in another interventional trial with interference of intervention or outcome of this study 
5. Any condition which could result in an undue risk for the patient in the opinion of the investigator
6. Expected lack of compliance or language problems
